About Aureon Get Help
Core Features

Everything you need,
in one place

Every Aureon feature is built to be fast, clear and secure, from your first transfer to your first loan.

Instant Transfers

Look up any Aureon account by number, confirm the name, enter your PIN. The money arrives instantly.

Five Currencies

Open USD, EUR, GBP, CAD and NGN accounts and move between them at the live Aureon rate.

Reviewed Transfers

Large payments and transfers to other banks are held for a quick review by our team before they leave.

In-app Support

Message our team from the Support page and get a notification the moment we reply.

Virtual Cards

Create cards for shopping or subscriptions, set spending limits, and freeze them with one tap.

Spending Insights

Income versus spending every month, broken down by category, so you always know where money goes.

PIN-secured Payments

A hashed 4-digit PIN authorises every payment. Five wrong attempts lock it for 15 minutes.

Savings Goals

Name a goal, set a target and a date, and move money in or out whenever you like.

Online Banking

Inside Aureon

Built for the way
you really bank

A closer look at what you can do from the moment your account opens.

Step 1

Create your profile with your name, email and a strong password. Your first account number is issued immediately.

Open your account
Takes about two minutes
Step 2

Choose a 4-digit transaction PIN. It authorises every payment you make, and it is stored as a one-way hash.

Set your PIN
Locks after five wrong attempts
Step 3

Share your account number to receive money, then send, save, pay bills and create virtual cards.

Fund it & go
Instant between Aureon accounts
Cards

Lost a card? Freeze it from the Cards page in one tap, then cancel it and create a new virtual card in seconds.

Freeze in one tap
Limits, online and contactless controls
Currencies

Hold up to six accounts across USD, EUR, GBP, CAD and NGN, and exchange between them at the live rate shown in the app.

Exchange instantly
Rates read live from Aureon
Support

Open a request from Support in the app and chat with our team. You get a notification as soon as we reply.

Talk to a person
Replies straight to your inbox
